svg.text: Figure 3. Empirical measurement ladder for SLK
Each gate adds a new estimand; failure later does not erase earlier claims.

g.text: G1 — Identify shared-axis conflict
Measure: opposing functional geometry on one phenotypic coordinate.
Ceiling if stop: multifunctionality may be shown, but conflict remains unproven.
G2 — Estimate or bound L
Measure: fitness-scale compromise load from a valid SCH-style receipt.
Ceiling if stop: real conflict quantified, architecture value still unknown.
G3 — Estimate recoverable release s or R
Measure: how much of L is actually recovered by the differentiated comparison.
Ceiling if stop: potential benefit known, but cost not yet paid.
G4 — Define and estimate K
Measure: developmental, maintenance, regulatory or other architecture cost on the same scale.
Ceiling if stop: R and K available, but the architecture crossing not yet evaluated.
G5 — Evaluate Φ = R − K
Classify: Φ<0 persistent compromise; Φ>0 global differentiated advantage.
Ceiling if stop: global value only; no claim of evolutionary realization.
G6 — Define local accessibility
Measure/test: mutational neighborhood, release path, or stepwise perturbations.
Ceiling if stop: reachable or trapped, but invasion still untested.
G7 — Estimate population feedback / invasion
Measure: rare-frequency performance and, where relevant, η-like frequency dependence.
Ceiling if stop: invasion phase known, fixation and occupancy unresolved.
G8 — Fixation model
Specify N, selection map, stochastic process.
Outputs: reciprocal ordering and/or
absolute advantage over neutrality.
G9 — Mutation connectivity
Specify graph and mutation symmetry/bias.
Output: weak-mutation monomorphic
stationary occupancy.

svg.text: End-to-end biological validation requires all gates relevant to the intended claim; SLK currently claims no single system has passed G1–G9.
